title: Failure Frame: I Became the Strongest and Annihilated Everything With Low-Level Spells
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Touka Mimori and his class are summoned by the goddess Vicius to fight the Demon Lord. Rated a useless E-rank, he is thrown into a monster-filled dungeon to die, but his 'status effect' skills prove devastating. He escapes, learns how cruel the goddess is, gathers allies such as the knight Seras, and plots revenge while letting everyone think he is dead.
life_message: Those who abuse and discard the weak deserve ruthless payback, while those who treat you well deserve loyalty.

content.note: Many enemies killed by poison, paralysis and other status effects; a character viciously tortured (Wikipedia; AniList Revenge 80; title's 'annihilated everything').
Abandonment in a deadly dungeon; cruel goddess; dark protagonist persona (Wikipedia; AniList tags).

Dignity vs honor.evidence: Mimori personally repays every insult and betrayal by Vicius.

Order vs freedom.evidence: He hides from all authority and follows his own code.

Civic vs kin.evidence: Kind only to his chosen allies; ruthless to outsiders.

Equality vs hierarchy.evidence: Rejects the goddess's ranking of people while leading his own band.

Tradition vs secular-rational.evidence: Treats the divine as a tyrant to be beaten with cunning.

Survival vs self-expression.evidence: Survival in the dungeon and strategic cunning dominate.

folkways.japan: The class-summoned isekai and bullying classmates echo Japanese school hierarchies, and the revenge hero is a popular light-novel archetype.

delivery.evidence: ANN manga guide: "Vicius is bad... and probably evil"; classmates "suck and are easily swayed"; themes "left pretty vague", not called preachy.

personified.ideology: Worth is set by rank; the weak are disposable
Ruthless payback for abusers, loyalty to allies

delivery.note: Revenge is carried by plot rather than speeches, and reviewers describe the goddess and classmates as thinly drawn, plainly evil antagonists.

winners_losers: Mimori and his allies win; the goddess Vicius and cruel classmates lose. Sympathy goes to the discarded avenger.
